dms.title: Dead Man's Switch
dms.text: A safety switch: if you stop checking in, the system reminds you first, then alerts your executor so the handover can begin. Check in again and everything stops.

crossConfirm.title: Cross-confirmers
crossConfirm.text: Trusted people who are asked "are they okay?" before the handover starts, so a missed check-in does not trigger it by mistake.

executor.title: Executor
executor.text: Someone you trust to handle the paperwork after you pass away, such as closing or transferring digital accounts.

kOfN.title: K of N people
kOfN.text: At least K of the N recipients must agree before the asset is opened. For example 2 of 3: any 2 of the 3 people are enough.
